How do animals interact with their environment? 

In this project you will: 
- Explore how animals use their senses in order to receive different types of information 
- Create and program an animal robot with a focus on its senses 
- Test your program and show how animals interact with different stimuli 
- Share your program and ideas
Find inspiration in the Design Library by looking at the different base models that you can use to build your own solution to this project.
Find inspiration in the Design Library by looking at the different base programs that you can use to program your own solution to this project.
